propositions: Compaction writes untracked SNAPSHOT.json and *.retired files without transactional rollback, leaving the working tree dirty on worker interruption.

Union merge in reconverge fails with 'untracked working tree files would be overwritten by merge' when origin has introduced the same untracked paths, causing abort-only failure and permanent store wedge.
Push recovery cannot clear untracked collision files because git reset --hard is tracked-only and _stash_create lacks the -u flag, leading to infinite retry loops.

On untracked-overwrite abort only, parse git's error message for exact paths, relocate them to a quarantine directory outside the worktree, and retry the merge to preserve both parents and stranded local commits.
All other merge failures (genuine content conflicts) maintain abort-only behavior and rebar fsck-recover hint unchanged; .tmp-event-* and untracked paths not named by git are left untouched.
